custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, with 3 in one bin location, bin location A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839433 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839433-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, click Track quantities and cost of goods off, type 3 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Have a tracked part, part B, with 4 on hand, so the lookup rows can be compared.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839433 PART B in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839433-B in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
    • How to do it: The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839433-.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test, purchase order A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO; pick any Vendor, type any existing part number in Part Number and pick it, type 1 in Quantity, click Add, then Save & Close. A purchase order made this way has no work order, so its page shows the Add Order Item button.
  • Start on purchase order A.
